WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-97.885648 41.076877, -97.885623 41.075496, -97.885622 41.075464, -97.895177 41.075501, -97.895179 41.075623, -97.89522 41.078095, -97.895223 41.078269, -97.895296 41.08272, -97.892685 41.082737, -97.892686 41.083311, -97.891214 41.083315, -97.889943 41.083319, -97.889928 41.083363, -97.889895 41.083398, -97.889855 41.083431, -97.889792 41.083455, -97.889733 41.083461, -97.885697 41.083465, -97.885668 41.079505, -97.885648 41.076877))', 4326) AS g
),
buffered_region AS (
  SELECT
    g,
    ST_Buffer(g::geography, 100)::geometry AS g_buffer
  FROM region
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, r.g_buffer)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN buffered_region r
    ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.g_buffer)
),
slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES', 111120) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
),
region_slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(s.rast, r.g) AS rast
  FROM slope s, buffered_region r
)
SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(rast, 1, TRUE)).mean AS slope
FROM region_slope;

WITH hordville_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Hordville'
    AND border_type ILIKE 'city'
    AND addr_state ILIKE 'Nebraska'
)
, slope_raster AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM hordville_geom), true),
      1,
      '32BF'
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM hordville_geom))
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(value), 2) AS avg_slope_degrees
FROM (
  SELECT
    (ST_SummaryStats(slope_rast, true)).*
  FROM slope_raster
) AS stats;
